dccWrittenLocalSimulatorEvidence.disclosure: Local Rezdy v1 HTTP server written and maintained by DCC in-repo to test OCTO-to-Rezdy v1 request/response translation, full-object PUT updates, stateless cross-instance execution, idempotency, hold expiry, timeout handling, and local persistence rollback without mutating live GoSno production inventory. This is NOT a Rezdy-hosted staging sandbox.

requiredAccountTypes.setupPath: Log in to https://app.rezdy-staging.com -> Settings / Integrations -> Rezdy API -> Generate Supplier API Key
requiredAccountTypes.capabilities: Full read/write access to supplier products, session inventory (/v1/availability), and booking lifecycle (/v1/bookings) for that staging supplier.

requiredAccountTypes.setupPath: Log in to https://app.rezdy-staging.com (Agent portal) -> Settings -> API Key, AND have the staging Supplier share a Negotiated Rate / Rate Sheet (e.g., 10% commission rate sheet) with the Agent.
requiredAccountTypes.capabilities: Read access to shared supplier products/sessions and write access to create/update/cancel bookings attributed to the Agent.

requiredEndpointPermissions: GET /v1/products and GET /v1/products/{productCode} (product metadata, priceOptions, bookingMode, confirmMode, bookingFields)
GET /v1/bookings?resellerReference={ref}&limit=100 (idempotent duplicate recovery by deterministic resellerReference)
GET /v1/bookings/{orderNumber} (retrieve full booking object prior to PUT update and for reconciliation)
POST /v1/bookings (create PROCESSING hold or CONFIRMED booking with customer, items, quantities, participants, fields, pickupLocation)
PUT /v1/bookings/{orderNumber} (submit complete retrieved booking object with permitted changes)
DELETE /v1/bookings/{orderNumber} (cancel hold or confirmed booking and release held session inventory)

writeOperationsPolicy.dccExecutionPolicy: DISABLED_BY_SAFETY_BOUNDARY — DCC never executes POST/PUT/DELETE against GoSno's live production Rezdy account during testing so zero live or paid production bookings are created.
writeOperationsPolicy.blockerSummary: Production Rezdy API keys are rejected by api.rezdy-staging.com with HTTP 401 (errorCode 4). Provider-hosted write tests require provisioning REZDY_STAGING_API_KEY in app.rezdy-staging.com.

statusSummary.directRezdyStagingApiWriteStatus: BLOCKED_MISSING_STAGING_API_KEY (api.rezdy-staging.com/v1 returned 401 'Invalid API Key' when probed with production key; requires separate REZDY_STAGING_API_KEY from app.rezdy-staging.com)

verifiedReadEndpoints.note: Not a valid Rezdy v1 endpoint; supplier identity is returned on /v1/products and /v1/bookings.
